t.script: import { jsonRpc } from "/web/static/lib/legacy/js/core/web.core.legacy.js"; // fallback path if needed // Prefer the modern import when available: try { const mod = await import("/web/assets/../@web/core/network/rpc.js"); window.__lxRpc = mod.rpc; } catch(e) { window.__lxRpc = function(url, params){ return jsonRpc(url, "call", params); }; } document.addEventListener("click", async (ev) => { const btn = ev.target.closest(".js-lx-remove-discount"); if (!btn) return; ev.preventDefault(); const row = btn.closest(".lx-discount-row"); const lineId = parseInt(row?.dataset.lineId || row?.getAttribute("data-line-id"), 10); if (!lineId) return; try { await window.__lxRpc("/shop/cart/update_json", { line_id: lineId, set_qty: 0 }); // Refresh the page (simplest) so totals and fragments are correct window.location.reload(); } catch (err) { console.error("Failed to remove discount line", err); } });
